columns.text: "Creation eagerly awaits the revealing of the sons of God" Rom 8:19-21

The sons of God, are first mentioned in the Old Testament. Who were those sons of God? Job 38:3-7 Why is creation still waiting for the sons of God? Rom 8:19-21 This is the story of Yahweh’s two families, the heavenly sons of God and the earthly sons of God. .

headings.name: Why did God create the heavens and the earth?

columns.text: Before everything existed, God wanted to dwell with a human family. 1 So He created the cosmos for mankind. God spoke the heavens and earth into being by His Word and the power of His Spirit. 2 Mankind was to be in awe of God. 3  While God created everything, heavenly beings watched and rejoiced when earth was created; 4 It was, and still is, the place where mankind will live with Yahweh forever.
1 Eph 1:3–5 2 Psa 33:6-9 3 Psa 147:4-5 4 Job 38:4-7 5 Jub 2:2-6

Then the moment arrived when God said, "Let US make mankind in OUR image and OUR likeness."  Mankind was to live in line with their heavenly intentions. So God, called Yahweh, created mankind, called Adam, the son of God, 1 and gave him dominion over the animals and all the earth. 2  He created them male and female so they could multiply and fill the earth. 3  This is the beginning of God's human family on earth and it is still growing.
1 Luk 3:38 2 Gen 1:26 3 Gen 1:27-28 Psa 82:1-2 Mrk 12:29-30 Eph 3:14-15 4 Heb 1:14 5 Zec 2:10-11 6 Rev 2:7
Yahweh planted a garden with the tree of Life; a place where Yahweh could be with His human family forever - a holy place called Eden. God walked with them in Eden -- everything was very good. 1

headings.name: How is God going to dwell with mankind again?

columns.text:
Adam unfortunately sinned and could not stay in Yahweh's presence.  

This website is the story of how Yahweh will make the way for His human family to return to His presence in a new Eden; a place where He can dwell with both His human and heavenly families forever -- Paradise.
